text:
incident-bot: SEV-2: Metering anomaly detected: token-count divergence +11.8% vs baseline across multiple customer buckets (us-west). Overcharge flags triggered for a subset. probe=mp-2026-03-16-04. runbook: metering/investigate-token-drift

sre-oncall: ack — joining bridge. First quick checks: emitter restart events, replay queue size, aggregator dedupe window. @billing-eng watch the charge flags and hold any auto-apply actions.

billing-eng: on it. Looking at aggregator logs now. I see an emitter-worker auto-restart at 01:12:09 UTC; shortly after, replay consumer shows ~2x emits for some windows. Possible replay + gateway retry duplication.

product-ops: p95 gateway latency spiked ~190ms at 01:12 (from traces). Clients saw a few 5xx/429s which likely retried. If retries were not idempotent we could get duplicate token emits.

liam: suggest temporary mitigation: flip replay consumer to "dedupe-mode" (idempotency enabled) and pause replay producer. If that's risky, at least scale replay consumer to drain without re-emitting duplicates.

maya: CS update: customers C-9 and D-13 reported overage flag emails at 01:20. No bills charged yet per billing console (flags only). I've placed both on a "do not bill" list pending investigation and notified them we're investigating. Preparing canned message.

sre-oncall: doing quick grep on proxy/emitter logs for duplicate emit id collisions:
```
# search for same emit_id reoccurrences
jq -r '.emit_id' /var/log/emitter/emits-01.log | sort | uniq -d | head -n 20
```
Found ~480 duplicate emit_id hits across 3 customers between 01:12:05-01:13:10.

billing-eng: also running a compare of shadow vs billing aggregates:
```
SELECT customer_id, window_ts, sum(tokens) as prod_tokens, sum(shadow_tokens) as shadow_tokens
FROM metering.aggregates
WHERE window_ts >= '2026-03-16T01:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id, window_ts
HAVING sum(shadow_tokens) - sum(tokens) > 100
ORDER BY (shadow_tokens - tokens) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
We see customers with shadow_tokens > prod_tokens by ~10-15% in affected windows.

cs-lead: prioritize customer-facing comms: short status, ETA for mitigation, and note we will not auto-charge for flagged windows. Maya, please queue the templated update.

liam: mitigation plan (short): 1) Pause replay producer (stop replays), 2) enable dedupe-mode on consumers, 3) temporarily suppress overcharge alerts/auto-apply in billing for affected windows, 4) run reconciliation job to compute true deltas, 5) lift suppressions only after reconcile and manual sign-off.

sre-oncall: executing step 1 now — pausing kafka topic replay via admin tool.

incident-bot: ACTION: kafka replay topic paused by sre-oncall at 01:26:12 UTC. Notifying watchers.

billing-eng: suppressing auto-apply for overcharge flags for window 01:00-01:30 for affected customers. Holding any billing changes.

product-ops: confirm which deploy introduced the non-idempotent behavior? Rolling back yesterday's emitter change (deploy 2026-03-15-18) is low-friction. Thoughts?

sre-oncall: rollback approved — initiating rollback of emitter service to 2026-03-14 build. Will monitor for new duplicates.

maya: CS: Sent update to impacted customers: "We identified a metering duplication during a replay event. We've paused replays, suppressed billing for flagged windows, and are reconciling counts. No charges will be applied while we investigate."

billing-eng: running reconciliation job in shadow mode (no writes) — ETA ~18 minutes. Script used: 
```
python tools/reconcile_counts.py --start '2026-03-16T01:00:00Z' --end '2026-03-16T01:30:00Z' --customers @impacted_list --mode dryrun
```
Will produce correction delta per customer.

liam: please add log snippet to incident doc: consumer traceback showed missing emit_id dedupe check in consumer branch: `if not seen(emit_id): process()` — looks like a missing redis TTL check after restart.

cs-lead: customer bridge still open; two customers joined earlier, both appreciative of the quick pause. We'll keep bridge for postmortem if they want.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Pager escalation not needed — oncall team handling. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-03-16-082 and assigning owners: postmortem-owner=billing-eng, mitigation-owner=sre-oncall, comms-owner=cs-lead.

sre-oncall: reconciliation finished. Preliminary deltas show ~+12% inflations for three customers in the window. No charges applied; will prepare correction plan.

billing-eng: correction plan: 1) compute final delta per customer, 2) apply billing suppression retroactively for affected windows, 3) run job to purge duplicate emits from billing datastore (idempotent delete by emit_id), 4) notify CS for customer notices and follow-up credits if applicable.

maya: draft to customers ready, waiting on final deltas. Suggest offering one free billing cycle credit for customers with visible anomalies >10%.

liam: follow-ups for postmortem: add a check in deploy pipeline to validate consumer idempotency, add emitter restart tests, and add a metering-side reconciliation alert that compares shadow vs prod aggregates with a small tolerance band.

cs-lead: agreed. Also recommend a Playbook: "If duplication >5% -> auto-suppress flags and open immediate bridge".

incident-bot: RESOLVE-INFO: all mitigations applied at 01:46 UTC: replay paused, emitter rolled back, dedupe enabled, billing suppression active. Incident state: under investigation -> mitigation in place. Will update postmortem template and escalate to retrospective.

billing-eng: final note: no customer bills were charged for the affected windows. We'll schedule a customer-facing summary after postmortem.

sre-oncall: closing bridge. Thanks everyone. Will file postmortem draft and assign to billing-eng.

maya: thanks team — CS will follow up with impacted customers tomorrow with final reconciliation details and compensation if needed.
